name: GitHub PR Iterate
description: Read an open pull request's review comments and CI status, judge each item's merit, plan per-item options, and apply fixes, replies, and thread resolutions only after the user approves the plan.

deps._runtime_contract: Skills are addressed by registered name; source values are install guidance only.

system.name: gh
system.purpose: Signed-in GitHub CLI for reading the pull request and, after approval, replying and resolving threads.

system.name: git
system.purpose: Committing and pushing approved fixes to the pull request's head branch.

input.arguments: An open GitHub pull request number or URL in the repository whose origin remote is on GitHub.

artifacts: A per-item feedback plan, then after approval one new commit pushed to the PR branch, approved replies, and resolved threads.
